params.caption: Ko'pchilik "actually"ni "aktual" deb o'ylaydi va "This topic is very actually" degan gap chiqadi. Afsuski, bunday deb bo'lmaydi 🙂 Actually "aktual" degani emas. Uning ma'nosi aslida, haqiqatda. Odatda kimdir o'ylagan narsa bilan haqiqiy holat farq qilganda ishlatiladi: I thought the test would be hard, but it was actually quite easy. Ya'ni test qiyin bo'ladi deb o'ylagandim, aslida ancha oson ekan. Suhbatda birovning gapini muloyim tuzatish uchun ham qulay: Actually, I'm from Samarkand, not Tashkent. Yoki fikringizni o'zgartirganingizda: Actually, let's meet tomorrow instead. Agar "aktual" demoqchi bo'lsangiz, relevant yoki topical deng: This problem is still relevant today. "Hozirda" ma'nosi uchun esa currently yoki at the moment: I'm currently preparing for IELTS. Speaking'da "actually"ni har gapga qo'shib yubormang, bir-ikki marta o'z joyida ishlatilsa, tabiiy eshitiladi. 📌 https://registan.edutizim.uz/order/entry/?survey=s33 📞 +998935512700 📱 Follow us on social media: 📱Telegram 📱Instagram 📱Location
